crossRefs.note: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites…
Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and…
their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy, of…
then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all…
When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the…
and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You…

parallels.note: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

translations.web: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
translations.bsb: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
translations.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
translations.asv: And they drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell in the midst of Ephraim unto this day, and are become servants to do taskwork.
